rating_criteria.label: README explains the project
rating_criteria.fix: Write a README.md of at least 1000 characters: what the project is, who it is for, its live site and where to report issues.

rating_criteria.label: One-line description
rating_criteria.fix: Add `.forkmesh/info.json` to the folder with a one-line `description` (and `website` if it has one), so Waypoint and the forge can show what the project is.

rating_criteria.label: Licence file
rating_criteria.fix: Add a LICENSE file to the folder (most BLT projects are AGPL-3.0; copy the repository root's LICENSE).

rating_criteria.label: Project logo
rating_criteria.fix: Add `logo.svg` (and `logo.png`) to the folder, following the logo guide on design.owaspblt.org.

rating_criteria.label: Tests run in CI
rating_criteria.fix: Add automated tests and a row for the folder in `scripts/ci/tests.tsv`, so every pull request runs them (`scripts/ci/test.sh <folder>`).

rating_criteria.label: Deploys automatically
rating_criteria.fix: Add the folder to `scripts/deploy/projects.tsv` with its deploy type, so merging to main deploys it.

rating_criteria.label: Live site
rating_criteria.fix: Give the Worker a custom domain under owaspblt.org (a `custom_domain` route in `wrangler.toml`) and make sure the home page loads.

rating_criteria.label: README links the live site
rating_criteria.fix: Put the live site's address near the top of the README (`**Live Site:** https://<name>.owaspblt.org/`).

rating_criteria.label: README shows how to run it
rating_criteria.fix: Add a "Run locally" (or Install / Getting started) section to the README with the exact commands in a code block, including how to run the tests.

rating_criteria.label: Uses the shared BLT top bar
rating_criteria.fix: Put the shared top bar first in every page (`<blt-nav project="<folder>" ...>` with `https://owaspblt.org/_shared/blt-nav.js`) and use the BLT theme: red-600 primary, neutral grays, light and dark mode, phone-friendly. See design.owaspblt.org and blt-waypoint/public.

rating_criteria.label: Contributing guide
rating_criteria.fix: Add CONTRIBUTING.md (or a Contributing section in the README): how to set up, test, and open a pull request on git.owaspblt.org, linking the root CONTRIBUTING.md and AI_POLICY.md.

rating_criteria.label: Commit in the last 90 days
rating_criteria.fix: Land a change: work through this project's open issues, or update its dependencies and docs.

rating_criteria.label: Two or more contributors this year
rating_criteria.fix: Grow the contributors: label a few small issues `good first issue` and link them from the README.

rating_criteria.label: No issue untouched for 60 days
rating_criteria.fix: Triage the open issues that have had no activity for 60 days: close, fix or comment on each.
